fields.title: portugal
fields.description: The publication covers contracting processes since 2018, using the [records endpoint](https://example.com/api) of the [source's API](https://example.com/docs).
fields.description_en: The publication covers contracting processes since 2018, using the [records endpoint](https://example.com/api) of the [source's API](https://example.com/docs).
fields.description_es: La publicación cubre los procesos de contratación desde 2018, usando el [punto final de registros](https://example.com/api) de la [API de la fuente](https://example.com/docs).
fields.description_ru: Публикация охватывает закупочные процессы с 2018 года и использует [конечную точку записей](https://example.com/api) [API источника](https://example.com/docs).
fields.description_long: The source publishes [tender data](https://example.com/tenders) and [award data](https://example.com/awards). Planning data is published separately, and is not covered.
fields.description_long_en: The source publishes [tender data](https://example.com/tenders) and [award data](https://example.com/awards). Planning data is published separately, and is not covered.
fields.description_long_es: La fuente publica [datos de licitaciones](https://example.com/tenders) y [datos de adjudicaciones](https://example.com/awards). Los datos de planificación se publican por separado y no están cubiertos.
fields.description_long_ru: Источник публикует [данные о тендерах](https://example.com/tenders) и [данные о наградах](https://example.com/awards). Данные о планировании публикуются отдельно и не охватываются.
fields.additional_data: The data uses the [Bid Statistics extension](https://example.com/extension) and the [Location extension](https://example.com/location).
fields.additional_data_en: The data uses the [Bid Statistics extension](https://example.com/extension) and the [Location extension](https://example.com/location).
fields.additional_data_es: Los datos usan la [extensión de estadísticas de ofertas](https://example.com/extension) y la [extensión de ubicación](https://example.com/location).
